c74object.name: bachmcp.gui.params
c74object.digest: Parameter panel for a bach-mcp algorithm
c74object.description: The panel of an algorithm's parameters (v8ui), which builds itself from the spec the runner sends when it loads a file, or from a .json (spec_file): one card per parameter (slider, range, toggle, menu, seed, curve, list), plus the runner's options and the algorithm's description. A synth or an fx shows knobs and a mute. Connect an instance's panel outlet to it and its outlet back to the instance. It shows each prompt's progress beside the type. It is saved with the patch, and works with pattr and pattrstorage when given a scripting name.

inlet.digest: From an instance's panel outlet; reset, bang, clear, autosize, set_name, set_type, spec_file ...

outlet.digest: To the instance: param, sync, bypass, mute, auto_dump, snap, capture, source_mode, process_only_selection, dump_selection_only

objarg.name: name
objarg.description: Shown while no algorithm is loaded, like set_name.

method.name: reset
method.description: Sets every parameter to its declared value, and sends them. Double-clicking a control does this for one.

method.name: bang
method.description: Sends the current value of every parameter.

method.name: clear
method.description: Forgets the parameters. The type stays.

method.name: autosize
method.description: 1 (default): the panel resizes itself to its content. 0: it keeps its size.

method.name: set_name
method.description: Drawn while no algorithm is loaded. Without a name: No algorithm loaded.

method.name: set_type
method.description: generator, transformer, selector, synth or fx: the base panel of that type before any algorithm is loaded. Kept by clear and saved with the patch. The instance's type echo does the same.

method.name: spec_file
method.description: Reads the parameters from a .json spec, the one send_gen writes for a synth or an fx (gen/<name>.json).

method.name: one_line_description
method.description: Replaces the algorithm's description drawn under the title. No text removes it.

method.name: prompt
method.description: An icon beside the type: received, queued, starting, sent, thinking, writing, calling / running <tool>, done and stopped fade after 4 seconds, error stays; idle removes it. The instance sends these.

method.name: bypass
method.description: Sets the bypass toggle without sending it.

method.name: mute
method.description: A synth or an fx: sets the mute toggle without sending it.

method.name: auto_dump
method.description: Sets the auto dump toggle (the instance's echo).

method.name: snap
method.description: 0 semitones, 1 quarter tones, 3 free (the instance's echo).

method.name: source_mode
method.description: 1 non-destructive, 0 destructive (the instance's echo).

method.name: process_only_selection
method.description: The instance's echo.

method.name: dump_selection_only
method.description: A selector's echo.

method.name: involutive
method.description: A selector's echo.

method.name: spec
method.description: The loaded algorithm's parameters, as the runner sends them: the panel builds itself from it.

method.name: set
method.description: Sets one parameter's value without sending it.

method.name: status
method.description: A line of status from the runner.

method.name: type
method.description: The same as set_type.
